lines.text: The "joined" rule is a working aid. Its candidates were checked, and 12 were left out because the broken thing is a kingdom, a horn, bows, a snare, a city wall, plans or winds (listed in the script). One known miss: Psa 38:8 *"I am feeble and crushed; I groan because of the tumult of my heart"*. Its "crushed" is H1794, which is taken by surface only for "contrite". It will be read with batch 3.
